=== DATA, IDATA, XDATA and CODE are EQU with an address space
; AS has none of these ASM51 words; with no linker and no address-space
; checks, each defines a plain value, which is what AS's EQU does.
COUNTER DATA    30H
STACK   IDATA   60H
BUFFER  XDATA   8000H
ENTRY   CODE    0100H
        MOV     COUNTER,#0
        MOV     SP,#STACK-1
        MOV     DPTR,#BUFFER
        MOVX    A,@DPTR
        LJMP    ENTRY
--- gnu
COUNTER EQU     30H
STACK   EQU     60H
BUFFER  EQU     8000H
ENTRY   EQU     0100H
        MOV     COUNTER,#0
        MOV     SP,#STACK-1
        MOV     DPTR,#BUFFER
        MOVX    A,@DPTR
        LJMP    ENTRY
=== an AJMP in the last two bytes of a block reaches the next one
; The CPU takes the block from the address after the AJMP, 800H here. AS and
; sdas8051 test the AJMP's own address, 7FEH, and refuse this; AS's generic
; JMP tests the address after it, and assembles what the CPU does.
        ORG     7FEH
        AJMP    0FF0H
--- gnu
        ORG     7FEH
        JMP     0FF0H
=== an ACALL straddling a block boundary calls into the next one
        ORG     17FFH
        ACALL   1C00H
--- gnu
        ORG     17FFH
        CALL    1C00H
=== the data list location counter is the item's own
; AS gives every item the statement's address.
        ORG     40H
        DW      $,$,$
--- gnu
        ORG     40H
        DW      40H,42H,44H
